payload.name: ASO Skill
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ASO Skill helps app developers and marketers research current Apple App Store search rankings and keyword autocomplete, compare difficulty and popularity, inspect app metadata, and check account credits through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: ASO Skill 帮助应用开发者和营销人员通过 ChatGPT 研究当前 Apple App Store 搜索排名和关键词自动补全、比较难度与热度、查看应用元数据，以及查询账号额度。

payload.name: Pod
payload.description: 来自用户和代理的评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pod is a living index of what actually happens when people and agents use things. Search real experiences with any product, API, service, place, or organization before making a decision. Then share yours to help the next person or agent.
payload.longDescription: Pod 是一个持续更新的索引，记录人们和代理实际使用各种事物时的体验。在做决定前，搜索有关任意产品、API、服务、地点或组织的真实体验。然后分享您的经历，帮助下一位用户或代理。

payload.name: juudd
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: juudd puts an AI-written project online without a second account to sign up for. Ask it to deploy, and you get a live site on your own subdomain with a Postgres database of its own — no build pipeline to configure, no dashboard to learn. Bring a project you already have: juudd accepts the files, serves them, and hands back a URL you can share. Custom domains, permanent versions with one-step rollback, and a plain record of every action taken on your account are included. Built for people who can direct an AI to write a working site but have never deployed one.
payload.longDescription: juudd 能让 AI 编写的项目上线，无需注册第二个账户。只要要求部署，就能在你自己的子域名上获得一个实时网站，并配有独立的 Postgres 数据库——无需配置构建流水线，也不用学习使用仪表板。你可以带来已有项目：juudd 接收文件、托管项目，并返回可分享的网址。还包含自定义域名、可一步回滚的永久版本，以及账户中每项操作的清晰记录。专为能够指挥 AI 编写可运行网站、但从未部署过网站的人打造。

payload.name: Prisma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Take your app from idea to a live URL with Prisma. Prisma brings together app hosting with Prisma Compute, managed databases with Prisma Postgres, and type-safe data access with Prisma ORM.

Build a new app with Prisma Composer or get an existing app ready for Compute. The plugin guides you through setup, local testing, and deployment, then checks that your live app works. Optional diagnostics use Prisma's MCP server to inspect deployment state and logs.

Requires ChatGPT's desktop app with local execution. Initially tested on macOS.

Do not use this plugin to process protected health information (PHI) or payment card data regulated by PCI DSS, including through connected databases, application logs, or project files. For healthcare or payment-related prototypes, use a separate environment containing synthetic data only.
payload.longDescription:
Prisma 可将应用从想法带到线上 URL：结合 Prisma Compute 应用托管、Prisma Postgres 托管数据库和 Prisma

ORM 类型安全的数据访问。使用 Prisma Composer 构建新应用，或让现有应用准备好在 Compute 上运行。插件会引导设置、本地测试和部署，然后检查线上应用是否正常；可选诊断使用 Prisma

MCP 服务器检查部署状态和日志。需要带本地执行功能的 ChatGPT

桌面应用，最初在 macOS 上测试。请勿使用此插件处理受保护健康信息（PHI）或 PCI DSS 监管的支付卡数据，包括连接数据库、应用日志或项目文件中的数据。医疗或支付相关原型应使用仅含合成数据的独立环境。

payload.name: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge lets authorized server owners inspect server health, work with approved files, and manage user-level processes from ChatGPT. Connections use OAuth with one-time owner pairing, and OpenAI reviewers receive a separate isolated demo environment.
payload.longDescription: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge让获授权的服务器所有者通过ChatGPT查看服务器健康状况、处理获批准的文件，并管理用户级进程。连接使用OAuth和一次性的所有者配对，OpenAI审核人员会获得一个独立隔离的演示环境。

payload.name: Cloudflare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cloudflare helps users search product documentation, discover API endpoints, and read, create, update, or delete resources across their Cloudflare accounts through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Cloudflare 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索产品文档、查找 API 端点，并跨其 Cloudflare 账户读取、创建、更新或删除资源。

payload.name: KERNEL
payload.description: 面向智能体的云浏览器
payload.summaryOriginal: a cloud browser for your agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: run cloud browsers from chatgpt. KERNEL gives your agent a real browser with full access to the internet: it can open any site, read and click through pages, fill out forms, and take screenshots. when a task needs one of your accounts, you sign in through a secure login panel that keeps passwords out of chat. each session runs in its own isolated cloud browser and shuts down when the task is done.
payload.longDescription: 从 ChatGPT 启动云浏览器。KERNEL 为你的智能体提供可访问整个互联网的真实浏览器：能够打开任意网站、阅读页面并点击操作、填写表单和截取屏幕截图。当任务需要使用你的账户时，你可以通过安全登录面板登录，密码不会进入聊天内容。每个会话都在独立隔离的云浏览器中运行，并会在任务完成后关闭。

payload.name: ApyHub US
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use ApyHub to find and call production APIs for tasks that need external processing. Search the catalog by capability, then call the endpoint that fits. Covers file conversion (Word, PDF, Excel, images), document generation, OCR and text extraction, data validation (email, phone, VAT, IBAN, tax IDs), enrichment, geolocation and IP data, currency and unit conversion, QR and barcode generation, archive handling, and AI utilities. Search first to see what is available, review the endpoint details, then execute. Each endpoint returns its own cost and certification metadata.
payload.longDescription: 使用 ApyHub 为需要外部处理的任务查找和调用生产级 API。按功能搜索目录，然后调用适合的端点。涵盖文件转换（Word、PDF、Excel、图像）、文档生成、OCR 和文本提取、数据验证（电子邮件、电话、VAT、IBAN、税务 ID）、信息补充、地理定位和 IP 数据、货币和单位转换、二维码和条形码生成、归档文件处理，以及 AI 实用工具。先搜索可用功能，查看端点详情，再执行。每个端点都返回自己的费用和认证元数据。

payload.name: TokenLab
payload.description: 统一设计准则，适用于所有人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Define the design truth for a brand, product, or system. Turn it into tokens, guidance, and production outputs while people, automations, and AI contribute through one reviewable workflow. Use TokenLab in ChatGPT and Codex to explore workspaces, projects, libraries, modes, aliases, and releases, resolve tokens for implementation, and prepare governed changes on branches for human review.
payload.longDescription: 为品牌、产品或系统定义统一的设计准则。将其转化为设计令牌、指导规范和生产成果，让人员、自动化流程与 AI 在一个可审查的工作流中共同参与。通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 使用 TokenLab，探索工作区、项目、资源库、模式、别名和发布版本，解析用于实现的令牌，并在分支上准备受治理的更改，供人工审查。

payload.name: Simple Commenter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read and act on website and asset feedback from Simple Commenter in ChatGPT and Codex. Search authorized projects, inspect comments with available screenshots, element context, replies, and captured JavaScript errors, and turn feedback into concrete development tasks. With the appropriate permissions, update statuses and priorities, reply to feedback, create comments, and generate exports and reports. The included fix-feedback skill guides a coding agent through investigating and fixing selected issues when the relevant codebase is available. Requires a Simple Commenter account and project access. Features depend on your account plan and granted permissions.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中读取并处理 Simple Commenter 中的网站和素材反馈。搜索已授权项目，查看评论及可用截图、元素上下文、回复和捕获的 JavaScript 错误，并将反馈转化为具体开发任务。拥有相应权限时，可以更新状态和优先级、回复反馈、创建评论，并生成导出文件和报告。如果有相关代码库，随附的 fix-feedback 技能会指导编码智能体调查并修复选定问题。需要 Simple Commenter 账户和项目访问权限。可用功能取决于账户套餐及授予的权限。

payload.name: Altifigence
payload.description: 读取 Cloud 工作区上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse your Altifigence Cloud projects, inspect workspace details, and read saved source files in ChatGPT. Use your authorized project context to understand designs and discuss code. The integration provides read-only access to the workspaces you are permitted to view.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中浏览 Altifigence Cloud 项目、查看工作区详情，并读取已保存的源文件。使用获授权的项目上下文理解设计并讨论代码。此集成提供对你获准查看的工作区的只读访问。

payload.name: ProdVerity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProdVerity is a read-only production verification plugin for developers and operators. It checks whether a public HTTPS web app is reachable, inspects common security headers, discovers an optional ProdVerity verification manifest, runs deterministic public health checks, and can compare a public build marker with an expected commit or release identifier. It does not log in, modify target applications, access private networks, or claim visual verification.
payload.longDescription: ProdVerity 是面向开发人员和运维人员的只读生产环境验证插件。它会检查公开的 HTTPS Web 应用能否访问，检查常见安全标头，发现可选的 ProdVerity 验证清单，运行确定性的公开健康检查，并可将公开构建标记与预期的提交或发布标识进行比较。它不会登录、修改目标应用、访问私有网络，也不会声称进行了视觉验证。

payload.name: Web Performance Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Web Performance Insights runs Lighthouse performance audits on web pages through its tool service, displays scores and Core Web Vitals with historical trends, retrieves real-user Chrome UX Report field data, compares or benchmarks multiple pages head-to-head, provides AI-powered recommendations to improve specific metrics, and exports audit results as downloadable PDF reports.
payload.longDescription: Web Performance Insights 通过其工具服务对网页运行 Lighthouse 性能审计，展示评分、Core Web Vitals 核心网页指标及历史趋势，检索真实用户 Chrome UX Report 现场数据，对多个页面进行并排比较或基准测试，提供由 AI 支持的具体指标优化建议，并将审计结果导出为可下载的 PDF 报告。

payload.name: Componecat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real software landscape: which team owns the billing service, what depends on the auth API, where the runbook for the payments gateway lives, or which endpoints a component exposes. Search takes precise filters, so one question can cover a whole slice of the catalog. Documentation for each component is available in full, including sections synced from Git, so you can read it and reason about it without leaving the conversation.

You can also keep the catalog current from chat: add or update components, record relationships, attach documentation links, and review recent activity.

Componecat's own product documentation is included too, so ChatGPT can explain how the platform works and walk you through it.

A Componecat account is required. Catalogs are private to your organization, and you sign in with your existing account when connecting.
payload.longDescription:
Componecat 是您组织的软件目录：您运行的每个系统、服务、库和 API，以及对应负责人、依赖项、文档和端点，全部集中一处。此插件让 ChatGPT 直接访问该目录。

用自然语言提问，获取真实软件版图中的答案：计费服务由哪个团队负责、哪些组件依赖身份验证 API、支付网关的运行手册在哪里，或某组件暴露哪些端点。搜索支持精确筛选，因此一个问题即可覆盖目录中的完整切片。每个组件的文档都可完整访问，包括从 Git 同步的章节，您无需离开对话即可阅读并进行推理。

您还可以在聊天中保持目录更新：添加或更新组件、记录关系、附加文档链接并查看近期活动。

Componecat 自身产品文档也包含在内，因此 ChatGPT 可以解释平台工作方式并引导您使用。

需要 Componecat 账户。目录对您的组织私有，连接时使用现有账户登录。

payload.name: OneSignal
payload.description: 设置电子邮件、推送和短信
payload.summaryOriginal: Set up email, push, and SMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OneSignal helps authenticated workspace users inspect messaging and audience data, manage users and templates, create segments, send notifications, and configure email delivery workflows through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: OneSignal帮助经过身份验证的工作区用户查看消息和受众数据，管理用户和模板，创建用户群体，发送通知，并通过ChatGPT配置电子邮件交付工作流程。

payload.name: Cortex — Semantic Memory
payload.description: 为 AI 提供共享记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cortex gives ChatGPT a durable memory that survives across conversations. Save decisions and notes, search them by meaning, and get a synthesized recall of what's known on a topic — always with traceable sources. When new information contradicts what you saved, Cortex flags the conflict instead of silently overwriting it. Your data stays bound to your own subscription account. A SKYNETLAB product, patent-protected and in production.
payload.longDescription: Cortex 为 ChatGPT 提供可跨对话保留的持久记忆。保存决策和笔记，按含义搜索，并获取对某个主题已知信息的综合回顾——始终附有可追溯的来源。当新信息与已保存内容冲突时，Cortex 会标记冲突，而不会悄然覆盖旧内容。你的数据仅与你自己的订阅账户绑定。此产品由 SKYNETLAB 开发，受专利保护，已投入生产使用。

payload.name: AgentiSend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AgentiSend is a transactional email API: send through verified domains with a message log, a free preflight that runs every gate a real send runs, and refusals that name the fix. Built so an agent can send on your behalf without ever exceeding a budget a person set. Unsolicited mail is refused by design; there is no tool for it.
payload.longDescription: AgentiSend是一款事务性邮件API：通过已验证的域名发送邮件，提供消息日志、执行真实发送全部检查关卡的免费预检查，以及明确指出修复方法的拒绝说明。它旨在让智能体代表你发送邮件，同时绝不超出人为设定的预算。系统按设计拒绝未经请求的邮件，也没有用于发送这类邮件的工具。

payload.name: Spacefast
payload.description: 构建并分享你的AI工作成果
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and share your AI work
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Publish the pages, reports, dashboards, and other artifacts you create with ChatGPT and get a link to share them. Spacefast lets you update existing sites, manage access, connect custom domains, and view or restore earlier versions. Connect your Spacefast account to manage your team's Spaces from the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT创建的页面、报告、仪表板和其他成果，生成可分享的链接。Spacefast支持更新现有网站、管理访问权限、连接自定义域名、查看或恢复早期版本。连接您的Spacefast账户，即可从对话中管理团队的Spaces。

payload.name: Samva
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Samva helps product teams inspect email readiness and delivery activity, send transactional email, and manage domains, senders, webhooks, templates, scheduled messages, and campaigns through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Samva 帮助产品团队通过 ChatGPT 检查电子邮件就绪状态和投递活动、发送事务性电子邮件，并管理域名、发件人、webhook、模板、定时消息和营销活动。

payload.name: Light Remote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Light Remote lets users connect ChatGPT to explicitly authorized devices they own, inspect device topology and effective policy, open durable sessions, work with files and Git, run bounded commands and managed processes, use real PTY/ConPTY terminals, recover job output after interruptions, and manage Main/Fleet device authority without silently switching targets.
payload.longDescription: Light Remote 让用户可以将 ChatGPT 连接到自己明确授权的设备，检查设备拓扑和有效策略，开启持久会话，处理文件和 Git，运行受限命令及托管进程，使用真实 PTY/ConPTY 终端，在中断后恢复作业输出，并管理 Main/Fleet 设备权限，而不会悄悄切换目标设备。

payload.name: Impreza Host
payload.description: 部署应用并管理服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Impreza Host is privacy-first offshore hosting. Connect your account and work with your infrastructure right in the conversation: list your servers, deploy an app from the curated catalog or straight from a git repository, follow the deploy and read container logs when something fails, manage domains and DNS records, control VPS power, snapshots and backups, and check invoices and balance.

Every tool acts only on the account you authenticate with, and the OAuth scope you grant (read, deploy or manage) decides what is callable. Read-only tools are labelled as such; anything that erases a disk, interrupts a live machine or affects billing is labelled destructive, so it can be confirmed with you before it runs. Purchases are completed on our checkout page, not inside the chat.
payload.longDescription:
Impreza Host 提供以隐私为先的离岸托管服务。关联账户后，你可以直接在对话中管理基础设施：列出服务器，从精选目录或 Git 仓库部署应用，在部署过程中查看进度，并在发生故障时阅读容器日志；管理域名和 DNS 记录；控制 VPS 电源、快照和备份；以及查看发票和余额。

每个工具仅操作你认证的账户，授予的 OAuth 权限范围（读取、部署或管理）决定可以调用哪些功能。只读工具会明确标注；擦除磁盘、中断运行中的机器或影响计费的操作会标记为破坏性操作，执行前可与你确认。购买需在我们的结账页面完成，不能在聊天中进行。

payload.name: Not Just You
payload.description: AI 服务状态，来源分开呈现
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check AI service status across official provider notices, community reports, and opt-in installed-client signals. Sources stay separate so you can compare the evidence yourself.
Read-only, no account required, and never reads prompts, files, credentials, or messages.
payload.longDescription:
通过官方服务商公告、社区报告和用户自愿提供的已安装客户端信号，查看 AI 服务状态。各来源分别呈现，方便你自行比较证据。
只读，无需账户，且绝不读取提示词、文件、凭据或消息。

payload.name: Swigs Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Swigs Cloud puts your project online in a single sentence. Give it a GitHub repository: the connector detects the framework, builds the project and publishes it over HTTPS on servers located Switzerland. You can then check the status of your sites, read deployment logs, manage environment variables and roll back to a previous version without leaving the conversation. Your data never leaves Swiss territory, backups included, and prices are in Swiss francs.
payload.longDescription: 只需一句话，Swigs Cloud 就能将你的项目上线。提供 GitHub 仓库后，连接器会识别框架、构建项目，并通过位于瑞士的服务器以 HTTPS 发布。之后，你可以直接在对话中查看网站状态、阅读部署日志、管理环境变量，并回滚到之前的版本。你的数据始终留在瑞士境内，备份也不例外；价格以瑞士法郎计价。

payload.name: GraphOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Apollo's official documentation, read documentation pages, and use the Apollo Connectors specification. Sign in to inspect GraphOS graphs, including variants, launches, lint results, persisted query status, and operation, client, and subgraph metrics.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Apollo 官方文档、阅读文档页面并使用 Apollo Connectors 规范。登录后可检查 GraphOS 图谱，包括变体、发布、lint 检查结果、持久化查询状态，以及操作、客户端和子图指标。

payload.name: nowyourlink Developer Docs
payload.description: 阅读 API 集成文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read published nowyourlink developer documentation in ChatGPT. Understand public API authentication, pagination, errors, request limits, versioning and privacy boundaries while building an integration. This documentation connection does not retrieve advertisements, access accounts, place bids or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中阅读已发布的 nowyourlink 开发者文档。构建集成时了解公共 API 的身份验证、分页、错误、请求限制、版本控制和隐私边界。此文档连接不会检索广告、访问账户、出价或处理付款。

payload.name: AstraVerify Domain Trust Check
payload.description: 电子邮件与AI发现性检查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AstraVerify checks whether a domain is trustworthy in the two places that matter today: the inbox and the AI answer. Ask about any domain and it returns two scores out of 100. Email Security covers MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, including whether DMARC is actually enforced, and every finding comes with the exact TXT record to paste. Discoverability covers what search engines and AI crawlers can actually get from the site: robots.txt rules for Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, whether the CDN blocks them at the edge, the sitemap, www/apex redirects, canonical tags, titles and descriptions, Organization and WebSite structured data, llms.txt, and whether the opening paragraphs define the brand. A fetch-as-crawler tool shows the exact response a named crawler receives, and verify_fix re-checks one area after you change something. Scores are computed by the same rules as astraverify.com, so what the assistant says matches the report page it links to. The server reads public DNS and public pages only, never logs in, never writes to your domain, and needs no account: results are cached and shared, and fresh scans are rate-limited per domain. Built for founders, marketing owners, IT generalists and the agencies that manage many domains.
payload.longDescription:
AstraVerify会检查域名在当今两个关键场景中的可信度：邮箱收件箱和AI回答。用户可查询任意域名，系统将返回两项满分均为100的评分。邮件安全模块涵盖MX、SPF、DKIM和DMARC检查，包括DMARC是否真正生效，每个检测结果均附带可直接粘贴的精确TXT记录。可发现性模块则检测搜索引擎和AI爬虫实际能获取的内容：Googlebot、Bingbot、GPTBot、ClaudeBot、OAI-SearchBot和PerplexityBot的robots.txt规则，CDN是否在边缘节点屏蔽爬虫，站点地图、www/域名重定向、规范标签、标题描述、组织结构数据和网页结构数据，llms.txt文件，以及首页段落是否明确定义品牌定位。提供模拟爬虫抓取工具可查看指定爬虫的实际响应结果，修改后可通过verify_fix功能重新检测特定区域。评分规则与astraverify.com完全一致，确保助手说明与关联的报告页面内容完全匹配。服务器仅读取公开的DNS和页面内容，不会登录您的域名，也不会向域名写入数据，无需账户即可使用：结果会缓存并共享，每个域名的完整扫描频率受限制。
专为创始人、市场负责人、IT通用工程师以及管理多个域名的机构设计。

payload.name: Tailor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tailor lets ChatGPT read Tailor Platform's public documentation and answer questions about building on it, grounded in the published docs rather than training data.

Tailor Platform is a headless ERP platform: define your data model, workflows, and permissions in code with the Tailor SDK, and get a GraphQL API, TailorDB, StateFlow workflows, Pipelines, Auth, and an App Shell for building business applications.

What this plugin does:
- search_knowledge: find documentation pages whose body text mentions a term, with an excerpt and a link for each hit
- list_knowledge: browse the table of contents by source or section
- fetch_knowledge: read a page as Markdown, or one section of a long page

Every answer can cite the exact page on docs.tailor.tech.

No account, sign-in, or token is required. The plugin only reads Tailor's published documentation; it cannot access any customer's application, data, or workspace. All tools are read-only.

Good for: developers evaluating or building on Tailor Platform, teams writing tailor.config.ts, and anyone asking how to do something in TailorDB, StateFlow, or the Tailor SDK.
payload.longDescription:
Tailor让ChatGPT可读取Tailor平台的公开文档，并基于已发布的文档而非训练数据，回答有关如何在其上开发的问题。

Tailor平台是一个无头ERP平台：通过Tailor SDK以代码定义数据模型、工作流和权限，即可获得GraphQL API、TailorDB、StateFlow工作流、Pipelines、认证功能，以及用于构建业务应用的App Shell。

此插件的功能包括：
- search_knowledge：查找正文包含特定术语的文档页面，每个匹配结果均附有摘要和链接
- list_knowledge：按来源或章节浏览目录
- fetch_knowledge：以Markdown格式读取页面内容，或仅获取长页面的某个章节

每个回答均可引用docs.tailor.tech上的具体页面。

无需账户、登录或令牌。
该插件仅读取Tailor已发布的文档；无法访问任何客户的程序、数据或工作区。
所有工具均为只读模式。

适用对象：评估或基于Tailor平台开发的开发者、编写tailor.config.ts文件的团队，以及询问如何在TailorDB、StateFlow或Tailor SDK中执行操作的用户。

payload.name: Blink
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Blink turns a description into a working app, with a database, sign-in, a backend and hosting, and publishes it to a live link. You do it all from this conversation.

What you can do:
• Build an app by describing it: a client portal, a booking site, an internal dashboard, a landing page or a mobile app.
• Change it by asking: "add a dark mode toggle" or "let clients approve deliverables".
• Answer Blink's questions right in the chat when it needs a decision, like which kind of app or which look.
• See the finished app right in the chat, with a screenshot and what changed, then publish it to a live URL.
• Look inside any project: list your projects, read the source at any saved version, compare two versions, query the database, and read backend logs when something fails.
• Restore an earlier version if a change went wrong.

How it works: connecting is a normal sign-in, and you choose which Blink workspace to grant. Code changes always go through Blink's agent, so your app's source and its saved versions stay in step. You can disconnect at any time from Blink Settings, Access Tokens, Connected apps.

您可以：
• 通过描述构建应用：客户门户、预订网站、内部仪表板、着陆页或移动应用。
• 通过提问修改应用：如「添加暗色模式切换」或「让客户批准交付物」。
• 在聊天中直接回答Blink的问题以做出决策，例如选择应用类型或外观。
• 在聊天中查看完成的应用程序，包含截图和变更记录，然后发布为实时URL。
• 查看任何项目详情：列出您的项目，查看任一保存版本的源代码，对比两个版本，查询数据库，在出现故障时查看后端日志。

payload.name: 1F916
payload.description: 记录AI代理接收到的指令内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SHA-256) are public. The text stays with you, or is stored encrypted to your key.

This app moves no money and calls nothing outside the 1F916 registry. Reading needs no sign-in. Writing asks you to sign in once: register the assistant as an agent with its own 1F916 handle, or connect one that already exists.
payload.longDescription:
1F916会创建可验证篡改的记录，记载AI代理接收到的指令及其执行操作。在执行操作前，助手会记录下收到的指令及即将采取的行动。执行完成后，会将结果追加到同一记录中。该功能还可对记忆进行密封，使后续会话能验证内容是否被修改。

每条记录都会被链接至公共日志。每隔数分钟，注册机构会对整份日志进行签名，独立见证人会共同签署这些签名，并将副本发送至比特币（OpenTimestamps）和Base链。任何后续篡改记录的行为都会导致与已发布签名不匹配，用户可通过该应用返回的包含性证明和一致性证明进行验证。

默认情况下仅公开指纹信息（SHA-256）。原始文本由您自行保管，或加密存储至您的密钥中。

该应用不涉及资金流转，也不会调用1F916注册机构以外的外部服务。阅读操作无需登录，写入操作只需完成一次身份验证：将助手注册为拥有独立1F916账号的代理，或连接已存在的账号。

payload.name: Uptimely
payload.description: 可用性监控与事件管理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Uptimely is an uptime monitoring and incident management platform. The Uptimely plugin lets ChatGPT work across your projects: read a project overview, list and open monitors along with their status history and targets, list and open incidents, list alerts, list maintenance windows, see who is currently on call, list status pages, and list telemetry services. With write access enabled it can also create a monitor, run an on-demand monitor probe, declare an incident, change incident or alert state, save a postmortem, and create an alert.

You connect by signing in to your existing Uptimely account over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, granting a subset of thirteen granular scopes at the consent screen; project API keys work for non-interactive clients. Every call names the project it acts on — there is no ambient current project — and access is checked against your real Uptimely membership, so one connection cannot reach a project you are not a member of. All seven write tools stay inert until a project owner turns on Allow AI write operations, which is off by default, because some of them page real people or change what a public status page shows. Connected assistants can be reviewed and revoked at any time from Connected AI apps in your user settings.

Twenty tools over Streamable HTTP: thirteen read-only and seven write. The six tools that dispatch outside Uptimely are marked as such in their metadata. The plugin processes no payments, generates no images, video, or audio, and serves no ads.
payload.longDescription:
Uptimely是一款可用性监控与事件管理平台。
Uptimely插件让ChatGPT在您的项目间协作：查看项目概览、列出并打开监控项及其状态历史和目标、列出并打开事件、列出警报、列出维护窗口、查看当前值班人员、列出状态页面以及列出遥测服务。
开启写入权限后，还可创建监控项、执行按需监控探测、声明事件、修改事件或警报状态、保存事后分析报告，并创建警报。

您可通过OAuth 2.1配合PKCE协议，使用现有Uptimely账户登录认证，授权时需在同意界面选择十三个细粒度权限范围中的部分权限；非交互式客户端可使用项目API密钥。
每次调用都会明确指定操作的项目——不存在隐式的当前项目——且访问权限会根据您真实的Uptimely成员身份进行验证，因此一个连接无法访问您非成员的项目。
所有七个写入工具在项目所有者开启「允许AI写入操作」功能前保持禁用状态，该功能默认处于关闭状态，因为部分操作会触发现实中的人员通知或修改公共状态页面内容。
可在用户设置中的「已连接的AI应用」里随时审查和撤销已连接的助手。

通过Streamable HTTP提供的二十个工具：十三个只读工具和七个写入工具。
六个会调用Uptimely外部服务的工具会在元数据中特别标注。
该插件不处理支付、不生成图片/视频/音频，也不提供任何广告。

payload.longDescription:
Grafana Assistant为Grafana带来专为场景设计的大语言模型，使运维人员、开发人员和站点可靠性工程师能在数分钟内排查问题、管理仪表板并解答产品相关问题。

无论是分析数据、为高管优化仪表板，还是引导团队成员获取导航与知识资源，Assistant都能消除手动查询操作，帮助团队提升工作效率。

通过让Assistant揭示关键洞察，组织可节省大量繁琐工作时间并降低运营成本，使工程师能够专注于更高价值的工作。

payload.name: Vibsync
payload.description: 在AI代理之间共享上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give AI coding agents shared long-term memory and live work context across tools, sessions, machines, and team members. Vibsync preserves discoveries, product knowledge, decisions, questions, tasks, and active work areas so the team does not repeat the same research or overwrite each other’s work. Git remains the source of truth; Vibsync is a collaboration context layer, not an agent orchestrator.
payload.longDescription: 为AI编码代理提供跨工具、会话、机器和团队成员的共享长期记忆和实时工作上下文。Vibsync会保留发现成果、产品知识、决策记录、问题清单、任务列表和活跃工作区域，避免团队重复进行相同研究或覆盖彼此的工作成果。Git仍然是唯一真理来源；Vibsync是协作上下文层，并非代理协调器。

payload.name: invinoveritas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Before you run something that can't be undone (a force-push, a production deploy, a destructive command, a config change), ask invinoveritas for a verdict: approve, approve with concerns, or reject, with issues ranked by severity and suggested fixes. The verdict can come back as a signed proof that anyone can check later without trusting us.

You can also verify a proof someone handed you (free), read the public verdict track record including the verdicts that turned out wrong (free), timestamp a third party's exact claim, reality-check a backtest, and audit an agent's verifiability.

A verdict is a reasoned second opinion, not a guarantee of outcome.
payload.longDescription:
在执行无法撤销的操作（如强制推送、生产环境部署、破坏性命令或配置更改）前，向invinoveritas请求裁决：获得批准、带顾虑的批准或拒绝，所有问题都将按严重程度排序并附带修复建议。
裁决结果将以可验证的签名证明形式返回，任何人都可在不依赖我们的前提下后续核查。

您也可以验证他人提供的证明（免费），查阅公开的裁决记录包括曾出错的裁决（免费），对第三方的精确主张进行时间戳认证，验证回测结果的真实性，并审计代理人的可验证性。

裁决提供的是有依据的第二意见，而非结果保证。

payload.name: Zenifra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zenifra helps users inspect authorized projects, operational health, metrics, builds, AI usage, and billing through a personal OAuth connection in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Zenifra通过ChatGPT中的个人OAuth连接，帮助用户检查授权项目、运营健康状况、指标、构建、AI使用情况和计费信息。

payload.name: Swagger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Swagger helps users find and inspect API definitions, apply governance rules, create or update private APIs, and manage and publish developer portal content through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Swagger帮助用户查找并检查API定义，应用治理规则，创建或更新私有API，并通过ChatGPT管理并发布开发者门户内容。

payload.name: Symbioza
payload.description: 在支出上限内运行GPU任务
payload.summaryOriginal: Run GPU jobs under a spend cap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Symbioza runs your containerized GPU job on a rented cloud machine and hands back the files it writes, under a spending limit you set. Describe the job (a container image, the command, links to its input data and a budget) and Symbioza gives you a free estimate first: the expected price, the time limit that applies and whether your prepaid credit covers it. Nothing runs until you approve the submit. Symbioza sizes the machine, runs the job and reports its progress, then returns the output files with their SHA-256 hashes and time-limited download links, and the charge. The budget is a hard ceiling: it is checked before a machine is booked and again before every retry, and you are never billed more than it. Use it for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, batch inference and preprocessing. Credit is added on the Symbioza website.
payload.longDescription: Symbioza在租用的云服务器上运行您的容器化GPU任务，并在您设定的支出限额内返回其生成的文件。描述任务（容器镜像、命令、输入数据链接和预算），Symbioza会先为您提供免费预估：包括预计价格、适用的时间限制以及您的预付信用额度是否足够。在您批准提交前，不会执行任何操作。Symbioza会配置机器、运行任务并报告进度，完成后将通过限时下载链接返回输出文件及其SHA-256哈希值，并附上费用明细。预算为硬性上限：在预订机器前和每次重试前都会进行检查，您永远不会被收取超过该限额的费用。可用于训练、微调、评估、批量推理和预处理。信用额度可通过Symbioza网站充值。

payload.name: Search1API
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search1API helps users research current information by searching the public web and news, reading full pages, discovering links on a site, and exploring trending GitHub repositories and Hacker News stories. It returns structured results with canonical source URLs for citation.
payload.longDescription: Search1API通过搜索公共网络和新闻、阅读完整页面、发现网站上的链接，以及探索热门的GitHub仓库和Hacker News话题，帮助用户进行实时信息调研。它会返回包含规范来源链接的结构化结果，便于引用。

payload.name: PromptBrake Free Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Prepare practical tests and release plans for your AI agents and chatbots. Get prompt-injection test inputs, map OWASP LLM risks to test prompts and warning signals, create an AI release plan with open decisions and a starter gate policy, and build a tests.json pack containing 1–20 response checks for PromptBrake CI.

These free tools require no account or API key. They help you prepare tests; they do not run scans against your application. Response checks use case-insensitive text comparisons, and the release-planning score measures planning completeness, not security assurance. Use test inputs only with systems you own or are authorized to test.
payload.longDescription:
为您的AI代理和聊天机器人准备实用测试及发布计划。
获取提示注入测试输入，将OWASP LLM风险映射到测试提示和预警信号，创建包含开放决策和启动门策略的AI发布计划，并构建包含1-20个响应检查的tests.json包以用于PromptBrake CI。

这些免费工具无需账户或API密钥。
它们帮助您准备测试；不会对您的应用程序进行扫描。
响应检查使用不区分大小写的文本比较，发布计划评分仅衡量计划完整性，而非安全保证。
仅在您拥有或获得授权测试的系统上使用测试输入。

payload.name: aso.best
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keyword research for the App Store and Google Play, from the stores' own numbers. Ask ChatGPT which phrases a competitor ranks for, including the hidden keyword field nobody can see; score any keyword with Apple Search Ads popularity and first-page difficulty; analyse a niche; compare where two apps rank; check Apple's top charts and an app's visibility; and follow your apps and keywords so aso.best reads their positions every morning. Numbers come from Apple and Google, never from estimates. Requires an aso.best account; the tools answer on paid plans, bought on aso.best.
payload.longDescription: 基于应用商店自身数据的应用商店和Google Play关键词研究。询问ChatGPT竞争对手排名的关键词，包括无法查看的隐藏关键词字段；通过苹果搜索广告热度和首屏难度为任意关键词评分；分析细分领域；对比两款应用的排名位置；查看苹果排行榜和应用可见性；跟踪您的应用和关键词，使aso.best每天早上读取它们的排名。数据来源于苹果和谷歌，从不使用估算数据。需要aso.best账户；工具仅对付费计划用户开放，需在aso.best购买。

payload.name: Recall.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Investigate meeting bots, recordings, transcripts, calendars, logs, webhooks, service health, and API documentation from your Recall.ai workspaces.
payload.longDescription: 从您的Recall.ai工作区中调查会议机器人、录音、文字记录、日历、日志、网络钩子、服务健康状态和API文档。

payload.name: worklore
payload.description: 开发者故事库，能力透视
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: worklore is a library of honest, agent-reproducible developer stories. Search stories and open their machine-readable "Reproduce this" contract so your agent can run the same fix in your own project; x-ray any skill or story to see what it can actually do (a capability tier T0-T4 bound to the content hash) before you run it; and record how a reproduction honestly went. Sign in with GitHub or Google.
payload.longDescription: Worklore 是一个包含真实可由代理复现的开发者故事的库。搜索故事并打开其可被机器读取的「复现此操作」合约，以便您的代理可在您自己的项目中运行相同的修复方案；在运行前，通过透视任何技能或故事，查看其实际功能（能力等级 T0-T4，与内容哈希绑定）；并记录复现过程的真实情况。使用 GitHub 或 Google 登录。

payload.name: VirusTotal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Investigate files, URLs, domains and IP addresses with VirusTotal threat intelligence. Read existing reports and interpret detections together with analysis dates and coverage. A missing report is an unknown result, not a safety verdict.

Analyze an explicitly authorized ChatGPT attachment using its original file object, or supply a small file as explicit bytes. VTAI hashes the original content and uploads it only after confirming that VirusTotal does not already know it. Contributing a new file does not spend report-query quota. Retrieving an existing report, including repeated lookups and analysis-status reads, consumes query quota; receipt recovery is free. File contributions have separate abuse limits.

For authorized network analysis, submit a URL or request domain/IP reanalysis. Keep each request ID, recover its receipt after an interruption, and follow its registered analysis without repeating an uncertain submission.

Connect with Google sign-in through VirusTotal AI (VTAI); no VirusTotal API key is required. Permissions and quotas apply to your account across connections. Revoke access from VTAI at any time.

Standard submissions are shared with VirusTotal and may be available to its security community and partners. Ask before sharing personal documents, internal code, credentials or personal data. Complete URLs, including query strings and fragments, are disclosed. The remote connector cannot read local filesystem paths. Report evidence does not guarantee safety.
payload.longDescription:
通过VirusTotal威胁情报调查文件、网址、域名和IP地址。查看现有报告并结合分析日期和覆盖范围解读检测结果。缺失报告表示未知结果，而非安全判定。

通过其原始文件对象显式授权分析ChatGPT附件，或直接提供小文件字节数据。VTAI会哈希原始内容，并在确认VirusTotal尚未收录该内容后才进行上传。贡献新文件不会消耗报告查询配额。获取现有报告（包括重复查询和分析状态读取）会消耗查询配额；接收恢复免费。文件贡献有独立的滥用限制。

对于已授权的网络分析，提交网址或请求重新分析域名/IP。保留每个请求ID，在中断后恢复凭证，并跟踪已注册的分析过程，避免重复不确定的提交。

通过VirusTotal AI（VTAI）使用谷歌账号登录；无需VirusTotal API密钥。您的账户在所有连接中均适用权限和配额限制。可随时撤销VTAI的访问权限。

标准提交内容会与VirusTotal共享，可能向其安全社区和合作伙伴开放。分享个人文档、内部代码、凭证或个人数据前请先征得同意。完整网址（包括查询字符串和片段）将被披露。远程连接器无法读取本地文件系统路径。报告证据不保证安全性。

payload.name: Protogrid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Protogrid is a public registry of MCP servers. Describe a task in plain words and it finds matching servers from the official MCP registry, tells you how each one connects (no sign-in, an API key, OAuth or a local package), and returns a ready-to-use configuration for clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or VS Code. Every server shows its tools, a change history of its tool definitions, and trust and quality scores built from our own credential-free checks. You can also check any remote MCP server URL for protocol support and directory readiness. protogrid is read-only: it never calls third-party tools and never asks for your credentials. Scores come from observable signals; no audit is implied.
payload.longDescription: Protogrid是MCP服务器的公共注册表。用普通文字描述任务，它将从官方MCP注册表中查找匹配的服务器，告知每个服务器的连接方式（无需登录、API密钥、OAuth或本地包），并为Claude Code、Codex、Cursor或VS Code等客户端返回即用型配置。每个服务器会显示其工具、工具定义的变更历史，以及通过我们自主的无凭证检测生成的信任和质量评分。您还可以检查任何远程MCP服务器URL的协议支持和目录就绪状态。Protogrid是只读的：它从不调用第三方工具，也从不请求您的凭证。评分来自可观察的信号；不表示任何审计。

payload.name: GitDiagram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GitDiagram shows how a public GitHub repository is built. Ask about a repository, for example "Show me the architecture of fastapi/fastapi", and you get its architecture diagram: an interactive map of the main components and how they connect, which you can pan, zoom and open full screen, and where every component opens its source code on GitHub.

With the diagram, ChatGPT also receives GitDiagram's written explanation of how the codebase is organized, the list of components with the paths they live in, how they connect, and the Mermaid source, so it can answer follow-up questions about the code and point you to the right files.

You can also search GitDiagram's library of diagrams by owner or repository name, and get a repository's narrated explainer video and its transcript when one exists.

It's for anyone getting to know an unfamiliar codebase: onboarding to a project, evaluating an open-source dependency, preparing a first contribution, or explaining how a project works.

Limitations: GitDiagram covers public GitHub repositories only. The plugin reads diagrams GitDiagram has already made; when a repository has none yet, it gives you a link to gitdiagram.com, where the diagram is made in about a minute, and after that the plugin can read it. Diagrams are AI-generated from the repository's files and can miss details, so check anything important against the code. The plugin is read-only, never changes anything on GitHub or elsewhere, and needs no account.
payload.longDescription:
GitDiagram展示公共GitHub仓库的构建方式。例如输入「显示fastapi/fastapi的架构图」，您将获得该仓库的架构图：一个交互式地图，展示主要组件及其连接方式，可进行平移、缩放和全屏查看，每个组件均可打开其在GitHub上的源代码。

通过该图表，ChatGPT还能获得GitDiagram对代码库组织方式的文字说明、包含路径的组件列表、组件间连接关系以及Mermaid源代码，从而能回答关于代码的后续问题并指引正确文件。

您还可以通过负责人或仓库名称搜索GitDiagram的图表库，当存在对应仓库的讲解视频时，还能获取该仓库的语音解说视频及其文字稿。

适用于任何需要了解陌生代码库的人群：项目入职、评估开源依赖项、准备首次贡献或解释项目运作方式时。

限制条件：GitDiagram仅支持公共GitHub仓库。插件读取GitDiagram已生成的图表；若仓库尚未生成图表，会提供跳转至gitdiagram.com的链接，该网站可在约1分钟内生成图表，之后插件即可读取。图表由AI根据仓库文件生成，可能遗漏细节，因此重要信息请对照代码核实。插件为只读模式，从不在GitHub或其他地方修改内容，且无需账户。

payload.name: Youmake
payload.description: 构建网站、应用和幻灯片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Youmake is a development workspace for creating and editing websites, mobile apps, and slide decks from natural-language instructions. It helps founders, designers, and developers turn project briefs into working software and presentations.

Connect your Youmake account to open projects you are authorized to access. Describe a new project or request changes through ChatGPT’s message box. Follow the coding agent in Chat logs, inspect the embedded preview, and stop an active build when needed.

Publish websites and slide projects to a Youmake subdomain or a domain you own after confirming the destination. Custom domains require DNS configuration. Mobile device testing and app-store publishing continue in the Youmake editor.
payload.longDescription:
Youmake是用于通过自然语言指令创建和编辑网站、移动应用及幻灯片演示文稿的开发工作台。它帮助创始人、设计师和开发人员将项目需求转化为可运行的软件和演示文稿。

将您的Youmake账户连接至您有权限访问的开放项目。通过ChatGPT的消息框描述新项目或提出修改请求。在聊天记录中跟踪编码代理的操作，查看嵌入式预览，并在需要时中止当前构建过程。

确认目标地址后，可将网站和幻灯片项目发布到Youmake子域名或您拥有的域名。自定义域名需要配置DNS。移动设备测试和应用商店发布仍将在Youmake编辑器中进行。

payload.name: Superlog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect the Slack channels where errors arrive and the repositories your team works on. Superlog investigates reports, opens bugfix pull requests when it can verify a fix, and replies in the original thread with its findings.

Describe what you want to automate, and we’ll walk you through getting started—from creating your Superlog account to connecting your tools and activating your first automation. You can also set up scheduled reliability checks, Sentry issue triage, and support workflows.

Connect an existing Superlog account or create one during setup.
payload.longDescription:
连接出现错误的Slack频道和团队工作的代码仓库。Superlog会调查错误报告，在确认修复方案后自动创建修复用的拉取请求，并在原始对话线程中回复调查结果。

描述您希望自动化的流程，我们将引导您完成入门设置——从创建Superlog账户到连接工具并启用首个自动化流程。您也可以设置定期可靠性检查、Sentry问题分类和客服工作流。

连接现有Superlog账户或在设置过程中创建新账户。

payload.name: Echo UI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Echo UI is a design system for React: components that press, click and move, all made from one material, with your own style on top. This plugin brings its workflow to your agent.

• Make a style. Share a mood board and ask for a style. Echo's Design Eye reads it as a designer would and hands back the style: a foundation document and a style.json you keep and reuse.
• Pick one. Ask which style fits your product. Echo's Style Fit places the product on seven axes, ranks Echo's styles and yours against it, and makes a pick it can argue for.
• Feel it. Wearing a style gives a link that makes https://echo-ui.com wear its colours, every component pressing and moving in them.
• Build with it. In a project with a terminal, where your agent runs commands, npx echo-ui-cli init --style <name> sets the project up in that style and your agent builds from Echo's components. In a chat, the agent writes the code with them and runs Echo's check on it before handing it over.

What it sends, runs and writes

• The server. The plugin's tools are Echo's MCP server, at https://mcp.echo-ui.com/mcp. It receives what a tool is called with: a search, a component's name, a style's settings, or code to check. It needs no account and keeps none of what it's sent: code is checked and forgotten. It reads Echo's published catalog and registry from https://echo-ui.com. Cloudflare, which hosts it, keeps request logs, including the address a request came from, for up to 7 days.
• In a project with a terminal, the skills run Echo's CLI, npx echo-ui-cli, which npm downloads and which reads Echo's registry from https://echo-ui.com. init, add and style use write into the project. init also adds Echo's block to the project's agent instructions, and Echo's check as a hook in its agent settings; npx echo-ui-cli agent off removes both. Design Eye and Style Fit save styles and decisions in the builder's style library, ~/Documents/styles, on their own computer.
• In a chat, nothing is saved anywhere: styles and decisions come back as files to keep.

Privacy policy: https://echo-ui.com/privacy. Help, privacy questions and security reports: support@echo-ui.com.
payload.longDescription:
Echo UI 是一个 React 设计系统：可点击、可交互的组件，全部采用同一种材质打造，并叠加你的专属风格。
此插件将它的工作流程带到你的代理中。

• 创建一种风格。
分享一个情绪版并请求风格设计。
Echo 的 Design Eye 会像设计师一样解析它，并返回风格方案：一份基础文档和一个你可以保存并重复使用的 style.json。
• 选择一种风格。
询问哪种风格更符合你的产品。
Echo 的 Style Fit 会将产品置于七个维度中进行评估，对 Echo 的风格和你的风格进行排名，并给出一个能论证的推荐。
• 体验风格。
应用风格后会生成一个链接，可让 https://echo-ui.com 使用该风格的颜色，每个组件的交互效果都会随之变化。
• 基于风格开发。
在包含终端的项目中，你的代理运行命令时，通过 npx echo-ui-cli init --style <名称> 即可按指定风格初始化项目，你的代理将基于 Echo 的组件进行开发。
在聊天中，代理会使用这些组件编写代码，并在交付前运行 Echo 的检查。

它发送、执行和编写的內容

• 服务器。
插件工具使用的是 Echo 的 MCP 服务器，地址为 https://mcp.echo-ui.com/mcp。
它接收工具调用的内容：搜索请求、组件名称、风格设置或待检查的代码。
无需账户且不保存任何接收到的内容：代码会被检查后立即丢弃。
它从 https://echo-ui.com 读取 Echo 的公开目录和注册表。
Cloudflare（其托管方）会保留请求日志，包括请求来源地址，最长保留7天。
• 在包含终端的项目中，技能会运行 Echo 的 CLI 工具 npx echo-ui-cli，该工具由 npm 下载，并从 https://echo-ui.com 读取 Echo 的注册表。init、add 和 style 命令会向项目中写入内容。init 还会在项目代理指令中添加 Echo 的模块，并在代理设置中添加 Echo 的检查钩子；运行 npx echo-ui-cli agent off 会移除两者。
Design Eye 和 Style Fit 会将风格和决策保存在开发者本地的样式库中（~/Documents/styles）。
• 在聊天中，任何内容都不会被保存：风格和决策会以文件形式返回供保存。

payload.name: Bird
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

A good first ask: "Send me a test email and tell me the moment it's delivered." Building an agent? "Claim yourself an email address and reply to whatever arrives."
payload.longDescription:
Bird是AI代理运行的通信基础设施。每个代理最终都需要与人类进行交互——验证注册、确认订单、催促发票、处理邮件收件箱、拨打电话。连接Bird和Codex即可真实完成所有操作：通过Bird自有发送基础设施和运营商连接发送邮件、短信和WhatsApp，通过Bird SIP中继进行电话沟通，通过Bird实时技术向每个打开的浏览器和应用发起实时事件——提供交付时间戳或确切的失败原因，而非猜测。

Codex不仅通过Bird发送信息——它还能掌控终端。它可在一次调用中为代理申请一个持久化电子邮件地址并处理收到的内容。它会购买电话号码、完成短信验证，并在该号码后注册10DLC活动。它会设置SIP中继并通过真实验证通话证明主叫号码。地址、号码、中继以及背后的合规性——所有内容均通过对话完成获取。

您账户能完成的任何操作，Codex都能实现。工具来自Bird的实时API——与Bird自身仪表盘使用的相同界面——因此Codex展示的列表始终为最新状态，并随Bird的更新而扩展。在连接前即可使用部分功能：实时检测任意域名的邮件认证、分析邮件头和DMARC报告，或搜索Bird文档，无需账户。

连接时通过Bird登录，无需粘贴API密钥或在config.toml中保存秘密。Codex仅获取您已拥有的权限，您可随时从Bird个人资料中撤销这些权限。

一个好的初始请求：「发送测试邮件并告知送达时刻」。若在构建代理：「为自己申请一个电子邮件地址并回复收到的内容」。

payload.name: Bubble
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Bubble account to inspect and edit your apps, including pages, elements, workflows, and data types. For Bubble builders working on their apps. Available actions depend on your account permissions and the access you grant.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Bubble账户连接以检查和编辑您的应用，包括页面、元素、工作流程和数据类型。
适用于正在开发应用的Bubble开发者。
可用操作取决于您的账户权限以及您授予的访问权限。

payload.name: Bland
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your Bland voice agents from ChatGPT. Review call transcripts and outcomes, check call volume and completion rates, and inspect saved agent configurations.

Ask Bland to place or stop a call, prepare an agent change, or deploy a selected saved version. You can also validate a supplied pathway graph, score calls with existing evaluation judges, and find answers in Bland's documentation.

Requires a Bland account and access to the connected organization. Sign in through Bland to connect. Calls and evaluation runs may consume your existing Bland credits. Pathway validation requires the graph's nodes and edges. Available actions depend on your account permissions and connected tools.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT管理您的Bland语音代理。
查看通话记录和结果，检查通话量和完成率，并查看保存的代理配置。

让Bland发起或终止通话，准备代理变更，或部署已保存的版本。
您还可以验证提供的路径图，使用现有评估裁判对通话进行评分，并在Bland文档中查找答案。

需要Bland账户及对关联组织的访问权限。
通过Bland登录以建立连接。
通话和评估运行可能会消耗您的Bland信用点。
路径验证需要图的节点和边。
可用操作取决于您的账户权限和连接的工具。

payload.name: Thrixel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build World turns a one-line game idea into a 3D game you can play in the browser. It settles what you are making, generates the 3D models with Thrixel (game-ready .glb files you own), writes the three.js game around them (scene, controls, UI and touch input), and publishes it to a public thrixel.world link you can share. Everything runs on Thrixel's servers, so there is nothing to install: connect your Thrixel account once and ask for a game.
payload.longDescription: Build World可将一句话的游戏创意转化为可在浏览器中游玩的3D游戏。它将确定您正在制作的内容，通过Thrixel生成3D模型（您拥有所有权的游戏就绪.glb文件），围绕这些模型编写three.js游戏（包含场景、控制、UI和触控输入），并通过可共享的thrixel.world公开链接进行发布。所有内容均在Thrixel的服务器上运行，因此无需任何安装：只需连接您的Thrixel账户一次并请求生成游戏。

payload.name: Currents
payload.description: 修复失败的测试。验证拉取请求。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Currents gives AI agents the test results your CI records, from Playwright, Vitest, Jest and more.

Self-healing tests
• Ask why a run failed and get the errors, stack traces, screenshots and traces behind it
• Step through a run's Playwright trace, action by action, to see what the page did
• Find the root cause and fix the test, flaky ones included
• Compare a pull request's runs with main to see what the change broke

Proof of work for any change
• Before-and-after screenshots, videos, Playwright traces and DOM snapshots from CI
• A demo the agent records in a browser, saved as a run
• Evidence links posted in the pull request, so reviewers see the change working

Test suite health
• Rank your flakiest and slowest tests and spec files
• See which errors break the most tests
• Quarantine, skip or tag tests with rules, and review what they affected

Day-to-day CI work
• Reproduce a bug from a failed run and verify the fix
• Open an issue for a failure in your issue tracker
• Cancel, reset or re-check runs without leaving the chat

For teams whose CI slows them down: flaky tests that block merges, failures nobody has time to dig into, and AI-written pull requests that are hard to trust without seeing the change work. Works with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Jira, Linear and more. You need a Currents account.
payload.longDescription:
Currents 会将你的 CI 记录的测试结果（来自 Playwright、Vitest、Jest 等）提供给 AI 代理。

自愈测试
• 查询运行失败原因并获取相关错误信息、堆栈跟踪、截图和追踪记录
• 逐步查看 Playwright 的运行追踪记录，逐个动作观察页面行为
• 定位根本原因并修复测试（包括不稳定的测试）
• 将拉取请求的运行结果与主分支对比，查看更改破坏了哪些内容

任何更改的证明
• 来自 CI 的前后截图、视频、Playwright 追踪记录和 DOM 快照
• 代理在浏览器中录制的演示，保存为一次运行
• 在拉取请求中发布证据链接，让评审人员直观看到更改效果

测试套件健康度
• 对最不稳定和最慢的测试及规格文件进行排名
• 查看哪些错误导致最多测试失败
• 通过规则对测试进行隔离、跳过或标记，并审查它们影响的内容

日常 CI 工作
• 从失败运行中复现错误并验证修复
• 在你的问题跟踪器中为失败创建工单
• 在不离开聊天界面的情况下取消、重置或重新检查运行

适用于 CI 成为瓶颈的团队：阻塞合并的不稳定测试、无人问津的失败问题，以及难以信任的 AI 编写拉取请求。支持 GitHub、GitLab、Slack、Jira、Linear 等平台。需要 Currents 账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find the root cause of failing tests, Fix flaky tests, Compare pull request runs with main, Find runs by branch, commit or pull request, Follow a test's history across runs, Rank flaky and slow tests and spec files, See which errors break the most tests, Quarantine, skip and tag tests, Review which tests a rule affected, Explore Playwright traces step by step through a trace API, Collect screenshots, videos and traces from CI, Capture real DOM snapshots as evidence, Record a browser demo of a change, Attach high-fidelity proof to pull requests: videos, traces and DOM snapshots of the change working, Create expiring share links to traces, Reproduce bugs and verify fixes, Open issues for test failures, Cancel, reset and delete runs, Cancel GitHub Actions workflows from a run, Integrate with Linear, Jira, Slack and more

payload.name: Openhandle
payload.description: 代理人的公开社交数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Openhandle reads public data from Instagram, TikTok, X, and Reddit. Ask for a profile, its posts, comments, followers, or search results, and get the same answer the Openhandle API returns.

You pick Test or Live when you connect. Test answers every tool with synthetic data, so you can try each one safely. Live reads real public data from the platforms.

With account access, you can also ask about your own Openhandle workspace: your usage, which requests failed, and which API keys are close to their limit.

Openhandle only reads public data. It cannot post, follow, like, message, or read private accounts. It cannot change your account or its settings.
payload.longDescription:
Openhandle从Instagram、TikTok、X和Reddit获取公开数据。
可请求资料档案、帖子、评论、关注者或搜索结果，获得与Openhandle API返回相同的响应。

连接时需选择测试模式或实时模式。
测试模式会用合成数据回答所有工具请求，可安全尝试每个功能。
实时模式会读取平台上的真实公开数据。

拥有账户权限后，还可查询自己的Openhandle工作区：使用情况、哪些请求失败，以及哪些API密钥接近使用限额。

Openhandle仅读取公开数据。
无法发布内容、关注账号、点赞、发送消息或查看私密账号。
无法修改您的账户或其设置。

payload.name: QueryHost
payload.description: 查询和比较游戏服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check and compare public game servers directly in chat. QueryHost returns live player counts, server versions, query response times, and available game details, with server cards and links to the full results. It supports Minecraft and other supported game protocols. No QueryHost account is required. Queries are read-only and restricted to public network targets. Response times are measured from QueryHost, not your connection. A failed query does not prove a server is offline, and server-supplied names, messages, and player data are untrusted content.
payload.longDescription: 在聊天中直接查询和比较公共游戏服务器。QueryHost会返回实时玩家数量、服务器版本、查询响应时间以及可用的游戏详情，包含服务器卡片和完整结果链接。它支持Minecraft及其他支持的游戏协议。无需QueryHost账户。查询为只读操作，仅限公共网络目标。响应时间由QueryHost测量，而非您的连接。查询失败并不证明服务器处于离线状态，且服务器提供的名称、消息和玩家数据属于不可信内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List supported games, Query public game servers, Compare public game servers

payload.name: Encore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Encore's cloud platform to inspect your applications, environments, deployments, infrastructure, and observability data. Diagnose production issues in your AWS/GCP environments using traces and metrics, inspect databases, review deployment status and build logs, and understand your API surface. Use ChatGPT scheduled tasks to set up ongoing monitoring or to give you daily updates on how your application is performing.
payload.longDescription:
将ChatGPT连接至Encore云平台，可检查您的应用程序、环境、部署、基础设施及可观测性数据。
通过追踪和指标诊断AWS/GCP环境中的生产问题，检查数据库，查看部署状态与构建日志，并了解您的API接口。
使用ChatGPT的计划任务设置持续监控，或获取应用性能的每日更新。

payload.name: Agentic Atlas
payload.description: 设计更优的智能体系统
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Design and review agent systems using published patterns, worked examples, glossary definitions, and decision records. Three skills help review an existing agent artifact, design a new agent system, and apply a named pattern. Five read-only MCP tools find relevant patterns, retrieve cards and exact sections, trace relationships, and provide a curated learning path. Recommendations cite their sources and distinguish published guidance from roadmap entries. Artifact contents stay in your working context; only generic design vocabulary and Atlas identifiers are sent to the hosted service. Applying a pattern can produce local edits when you authorize them. No account is required.
payload.longDescription: 通过已发布的模式、示例、术语表定义和决策记录，设计并评审智能体系统。三项技能可帮助您评审现有智能体制品、设计新的智能体系统，以及应用命名模式。五种只读MCP工具可查找相关模式、检索卡片和具体章节、追踪关系，并提供定制的学习路径。推荐内容会引用来源，并区分已发布指南与路线图条目。制品内容保留在您的工作上下文中；仅通用设计术语和Atlas标识符会发送至托管服务。授权后应用模式可生成本地编辑。无需账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Review agent designs, Design agent systems, Apply a named pattern, Consult published patterns

payload.name: GrowthBook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your GrowthBook account to create and update feature flags, set up and analyze experiments, and manage metrics. Built-in GrowthBook skills guide common workflows like rolling out a flag safely or reading experiment results.
payload.longDescription:
将ChatGPT连接到您的GrowthBook账户，可创建和更新功能开关、设置并分析实验、管理指标。
内置的GrowthBook功能可指导常见操作流程，例如安全推出功能开关或查看实验结果。

payload.name: Meeem
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and edit hosted websites, web apps and browser games with Meeem. Check your plan, Build Credits and saved-app allowance, inspect your projects and track build progress. Choose Quick for a standard build or explicitly request Studio. Hosted links are accessible to anyone with the link. Community-feed publication is a separate action. A Meeem account is required.
payload.longDescription: 使用Meeem构建和编辑托管网站、网页应用及浏览器游戏。查看您的计划、构建积分和已保存应用配额，检查项目并跟踪构建进度。选择快速构建进行标准构建，或明确请求专业版。托管链接可被拥有该链接的任何人访问。社区动态发布是单独操作。需要Meeem账户。

payload.name: Tavus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and manage Tavus PALs through conversation. Choose available faces and voices, configure behavior and knowledge, run text tests, and open a video preview. Connect your Tavus account to access its resources and existing entitlements. Includes the same tools as the hosted Tavus MCP server. Custom face training, rendered video generation, PAL sales, and ownership transfers are not exposed by this integration.
payload.longDescription: 通过对话构建和管理Tavus PALs。选择可用的面部和声音，配置行为和知识，运行文本测试，并打开视频预览。连接您的Tavus账户以访问其资源和现有权限。包含与托管的Tavus MCP服务器相同的工具。自定义面部训练、渲染视频生成、PAL销售和所有权转移不通过此集成提供。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create PALs, Edit PAL behavior and knowledge, Test conversations, Open video previews

payload.name: Fluenticons
payload.description: 适用于代码的Fluent UI图标搜索工具
payload.summaryOriginal: Fluent UI icon search for code
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons by meaning ("user permissions", "billing", "delete") and get component names that exist in @fluentui/react-icons, with imports and code for React, SVG, Blazor, Flutter, WinUI/WPF, the icon font, Android, iOS and Power Apps. Pick a matching set for navigation or menus in one call. Search is deterministic: it matches icon names, Microsoft's keywords and a synonym list, so it never invents an icon. No sign-in required. Fluenticons is independent and not affiliated with Microsoft; the icons are Microsoft's, under the MIT License.
payload.longDescription: 通过含义（如「用户权限」、「计费」、「删除」）查找微软Fluent UI系统图标，并获取@fluentui/react-icons中存在的组件名称，包含React、SVG、Blazor、Flutter、WinUI/WPF、图标字体、Android、iOS及Power Apps的导入方式和代码示例。可一次性选取适用于导航或菜单的图标集。搜索具有确定性：通过匹配图标名称、微软关键词及同义词列表进行检索，因此不会凭空生成图标。无需登录。Fluenticons为独立工具，与微软无关联；图标版权属于微软，采用MIT协议授权。

payload.name: Magnet AEO/GEO Audit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn a website domain into a clear starting point for AI search improvement. Magnet by ProjectA.ai runs an AEO/GEO audit, explains your scores, and helps you prioritize practical next steps. Explore structured data, content depth, entity authority, technical AEO and available AI visibility evidence. Get a publicly accessible report you can share, plus an explanation in your conversation. Built for website owners, marketers and developers. Data availability varies, and heuristic scores estimate readiness rather than prove actual AI mentions. Results do not guarantee rankings or inclusion in AI answers. The submitted domain is processed by ProjectA and its audit providers. Service limits apply.
payload.longDescription:
将网站域名转化为人工智能搜索优化的明确起点。
由ProjectA.ai推出的Magnet工具会执行AEO/GEO审计，解释您的评分，并帮助您确定实际的下一步行动。
探索结构化数据、内容深度、实体权威性、技术性AEO以及可用的人工智能可见性证据。
可分享的公开报告，以及在对话中的解释。
专为网站所有者、营销人员和开发者打造。
数据可用性各不相同，启发式评分用于估计准备度，而非证明实际的人工智能提及。
结果不保证排名或被纳入人工智能答案中。
提交的域名将由ProjectA及其审计合作伙伴进行处理。
服务限制适用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Audit a public website, Read audit scores and evidence, Prioritize AEO/GEO improvements

payload.name: Exness
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access public Exness API documentation to understand API key setup, request signing, account host discovery, rate limits, and troubleshooting. No sign-in is required. This version provides documentation only: it does not access trading accounts, retrieve live trading or partnership data, execute trades, or change settings.
payload.longDescription:
访问公开的Exness API文档，了解API密钥设置、请求签名、账户主机发现、速率限制和故障排除方法。
无需登录即可使用。

payload.name: SportsAPIs.dev
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SportsAPIs.dev helps developers pick a sports odds API or sports data API for the app, model or odds comparison tool they are building. The plugin answers from the SportsAPIs.dev directory: 42 providers researched by hand, with a written review page for each one.

What it does:
- Find sports APIs by what you need: sport or league (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, tennis, esports and more), live odds, WebSocket streaming, Bet365 or Pinnacle odds, historical and closing odds, player props, futures, same game parlay odds, bet deeplinks, bet settlement, stats, schedules, live scores, box scores, play-by-play and official MCP servers. Filter by free tier, price tier and region.
- Compare two to four providers side by side on the same researched feature set, with the differences called out.
- Read what the SportsAPIs.dev review says about one provider: feature support, pricing tiers, strengths, the full review text, FAQs and alternatives.

Every answer links to the matching review page on sportsapis.dev, so you can read the full write-up and reach the provider from there.

Who it is for: developers building sports apps, betting tools, odds comparison sites, sports analytics, trading models or AI agents that need a sports odds API, a sportsbook odds feed or a sports data API.

Limitations: the plugin covers API providers only. It has no live odds, no scores and no match data, and it gives no betting picks or wagering advice. Feature statuses come from SportsAPIs.dev research (yes, no, or unknown when unverified or plan-dependent). Sport lists reflect sports named in each written review, not a verified coverage list; check the provider's own docs before you build. Some provider links carry SportsAPIs.dev referral parameters, disclosed on the site; they cost you nothing.
payload.longDescription:
SportsAPIs.dev帮助开发者为其正在构建的应用程序、模型或赔率比价工具选择体育赔率API或体育数据API。
该插件从SportsAPIs.dev目录中提供答案：42个经过人工调研的供应商，每个供应商都有对应的书面评测页面。

其功能包括：
- 根据需求查找体育API：运动或联赛（NFL、NBA、MLB、NHL、足球、网球、电子竞技等）、实时赔率、WebSocket流媒体、Bet365或Pinnacle赔率、历史赔率和终盘赔率、球员属性、未来投注、同一赛事串关赔率、投注深度链接、投注结算、统计数据、赛程安排、实时比分、技术统计、逐球播报及官方MCP服务器。
按免费层级、价格层级和地区进行筛选。
- 将两到四个供应商在同一研究功能集上进行对比，突出显示差异。
- 阅读SportsAPIs.dev评测对单个供应商的评价：功能支持情况、价格层级、优势、完整评测文本、常见问题及替代方案。

每个答案都会链接至SportsAPIs.dev上的对应评测页面，您可以阅读完整评测内容并从此处直达供应商。

适用对象：开发体育应用、投注工具、赔率比价网站、体育分析、交易模型或需要体育赔率API、体育博彩赔率数据源或体育数据API的开发者。

限制条件：该插件仅涵盖API供应商。
不提供实时赔率、比分数据或比赛数据，也不提供投注建议或下注指导。
功能状态来源于SportsAPIs.dev的研究结果（未验证或依赖计划时显示“未知”）。
运动列表反映各书面评测中提及的运动项目，并非经过验证的覆盖列表；在开发前请查阅供应商官方文档。
部分供应商链接包含SportsAPIs.dev推荐参数，该网站已对此进行说明；不会产生任何费用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find sports odds and data APIs, Compare API providers, Read provider reviews

payload.name: Stoic Video Doctor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A developer troubleshooting tool for technical video metadata on Mac. Analyze pasted ffprobe JSON or MediaInfo JSON/Text reports to identify codec, resolution, HDR transfer characteristics and subtitle track types. Explain likely decoding and subtitle compatibility issues with evidence, sources and next diagnostic steps. Includes Stoic 1.2 release notes; decoder diagnostics remain pinned to verified Stoic 1.1 engine rules.
